fieldValues.title: Execution
fieldValues.theory: One issue per session, in a fresh worktree, with gates judged by exit code. The ship stages run: plan, design pause, review, docs, dogfood.
fieldValues.practice:
- Briefs: `routines/wg-builder.md`, `routines/unattended-worker.md`. Both call `clerk claim` first; the unattended worker acts as `agent:unattended-worker`.
- Worktrees only through `scripts/wt new <repo> <issue#-slug>`.
fieldValues.test: Stage 12: pending (no pure function to assert; briefs and scripts/wt only).
